onset.Description: Onset of the event, in seconds from the start of the run.

duration.Description: Duration of the event in seconds. Zero for point events. On a Repetition row, the length of its .mp4 replay: its frame count divided by the frame rate; n/a when the .mp4 is missing.

logged_duration.Description: Duration of the repetition logged by the task, from the plain events.tsv. Set on the Repetition row only, including when the .mp4 is missing.

onset_in_video.Description: Onset of the event in its repetition's replay video (game_replays/*_recording.mp4, the repetition's stim_file), in seconds from the video's first frame: frame_start divided by the frame rate. n/a for a repetition without a replay.

trial_type.Description: Event type: a family, optionally followed by qualifiers separated by `/`, e.g. `EnemyDefeated/Stomp/Goomba`. `Levels` lists every value.

Levels.Repetition: One stretch of play recorded in a single replay file; every other event falls inside it.
Levels.Screen/Death: The death animation plays after the player dies.
Levels.Screen/GameOver: The GAME OVER screen appears after the last life is lost.
Levels.Screen/Gameplay: The player controls the character during gameplay.
Levels.Screen/LevelEnd: The level-clear sequence plays after the player finishes the stage.
Levels.Screen/Transition: The game shows travel between areas or a fade into play.
Levels.Action/Attack: The player presses attack to strike nearby enemies or throw shuriken; holding it guards.
Levels.Action/Down: The player holds down to crouch or presses down with jump to drop from overhead supports.
Levels.Action/Jump: The player presses jump to leap, double-jump or kick off a wall.
Levels.Action/Left: The player holds left to move or steer left.
Levels.Action/Ninjutsu: The player presses ninjutsu to cast the selected ninja spell.
Levels.Action/Right: The player holds right to move or steer right.
Levels.Action/Start: The player presses start to pause the game.
Levels.Action/Up: The player presses up with jump to grab a ceiling, rope or overhead beam.
Levels.EnemyDefeated: The player defeats an enemy during combat.
Levels.HealthGained: The player picks up a recovery item and heals.
Levels.ItemCollected/Shurikens: The player collects shuriken ammunition to replenish the supply.
Levels.LevelCompleted: The player reaches the goal and completes the level.
Levels.LevelStarted: A new attempt begins at the start of the level.
Levels.LifeGained: The player earns an extra life.
Levels.PlayerDamaged: The player is hit and gets hurt but survives.
Levels.PlayerDied/Enemy: The player dies after running out of energy.
Levels.PlayerDied/Fall: The player falls into a pit or into water and dies.
Levels.PlayerState/HitRecovery: The player blinks after being hit and is briefly invulnerable.
Levels.PlayerState/Normal: The player controls the ninja in his usual form.
Levels.ProjectileAppeared/Shuriken: The player throws a shuriken through the air.
Levels.WeaponPowerupStarted/Ninjutsu: The player casts ninjutsu magic using an available spell.

frame_start.Description: Index of the first emulator frame of the event, relative to the start of its repetition.

frame_stop.Description: Index of the last emulator frame of the event, relative to the start of its repetition.

button.Description: Raw controller button underlying an Action/* event; `Levels` gives the event each button produces. n/a for all other events.

stim_file.Description: Path to the .mp4 replay of the repetition. Set on the Repetition row only; every other event falls inside exactly one of those windows. Per-repetition metadata (phase, IndexInRun, IndexGlobal, IndexLevel, Outcome) live in the matching game_replays/*_summary.json. 'Missing File' marks a repetition whose .bk2 (used to construct the .mp4) was lost; its row is kept, with no events inside it.
